name: app-release
description: Application code release / deployment to an environment

fields.justification: Scheduled application release per the release calendar
fields.implementation_plan: Blue/green deployment executed through the change tasks; traffic switched only after smoke tests pass.
fields.backout_plan: Switch traffic back to the previous slot (approx. 5 minutes); database migrations are backward compatible.
fields.test_plan: Smoke test suite passes, error rate below 0.1% for 30 minutes after switch, key business flows checked by application owner.

description_sections.heading: 变更对象
description_sections.hint: 应用名、版本号、目标环境、部署到哪些服务器

description_sections.heading: 版本内容
description_sections.hint: 发布单号、主要功能和修复 (ticket 编号)、是否含数据库变更

description_sections.heading: 影响范围
description_sections.hint: 用户是否有感知、停机时长、受影响的接口或下游系统

description_sections.heading: 执行步骤
description_sections.hint: 见 change tasks,说明切换方式 (蓝绿/滚动)

description_sections.heading: 验证方法
description_sections.hint: 冒烟用例数量、监控指标和阈值、业务方验收

description_sections.heading: 回退方案
description_sections.hint: 回退到哪个版本、动作、耗时、数据库是否可回退
